_note: Paths REMOVED from LifeOS upstream. OverlaySystem.ts reads this on every update and MOVES each matching path in the install tree into <configRoot>/.retired-<timestamp>/ — never deletes it. Without this list the overlay can only add and refresh, so a hook, tool or skill LifeOS removed lives on the user's disk forever, still firing and still resolving.
_rules: path must be a strict descendant of an overlay-owned root: hooks/, skills/, agents/, commands/, or LIFEOS/{TOOLS,DOCUMENTATION,ALGORITHM,RULES,PULSE,ATLAS,HERMES,USER_TEMPLATES,ROUTER,ASSAY,ERRATA,SOCRATES,VERA,PEOPLE,RELAY,CODEX,PI,AS3,GAUNTLET,MAESTRO,WORKFLOWS,DICTATION,LOCATION,REVIEW,SETUP,EVIDENCE,IDEALSTATE,STATUSLINE}/
bare roots, CLAUDE.md, LIFEOS/LIFEOS_SYSTEM_PROMPT.md, settings*.json, .env*, USER, and LIFEOS/USER or LIFEOS/MEMORY are refused
path is relative, never absolute and never containing a dot segment or backslash
an already-absent path is a no-op; present paths are moved into .retired-* and never deleted
